description: Rig-upgrade drain over ~/.cuttlefish/runner-state/micropod-maintenance.sock. One JSON object per line each way. Micropod's RigCuttlefishDrain and Cuttlefish's maintenance server both test against this file.

reply.reason: Waiting for existing work; work still running after 1m0s is preempted and handed back
Another runtime operation retains host maintenance
Another runtime operation retains host maintenance

replies.reason: Action outcome is uncertain; abort is refused

transport.closedWithoutReply: drain: incompatible (an older Cuttlefish rejects the unknown kind field by closing the connection); abort: rejected, which ends the drain only if it was never acknowledged with draining or drained
transport.notSent: unavailable: no coordinator, or its identity could not be verified before the request was written

cuttlefishMustImplement: Accept a maintenance-socket peer signed com.skunkworq.micropod.cli (team WFTX6CN23F), as well as com.skunkworq.micropod, for kind rig-upgrade.
Decode a kind field in the call: it is rejected today by DisallowUnknownFields on micropodMaintenanceCall.
For kind rig-upgrade, skip the installRoot (validManagedRuntimeRoot), version, packageSHA256, localGeneration and targetState checks: the request carries none of them.
For kind rig-upgrade, take no host fence, and on abortComplete do not require the local admission fence.json to be absent.

Always answer a decoded rig-upgrade call with one reply line: draining, drained or refused/blocked with a reason for drain; aborting then cancelled for the release; blocked with a reason containing 'unknown' for an operation it never recorded.
Preempt attempts still running after the grace, hand them back with maintenance_preempted, and release a hold with no call for two minutes.
